deletion.title: Susa i-akhawunti
deletion.description: I-akhawunti yakho iyavalwa khona manje, njalo ulwazi lwakho lomuntu siqu lususwa unomphela ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-{{days}}.
consequences: Uyakhutshwa kuzo zonke izinto ozisebenzisayo, njalo izaziso ze-push ziyama khona manje.
Ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-{{days}}, iphrofayili yakho, ulwazi lokukuthinta, ulwazi lomuntu siqu lolwempilo lokubhalisa kwakho, umlando we-GPS, abagijimi obalandelayo lezaziso kuyasuswa.
Imiphumela yemijaho lamarekhodi enkokhelo kugcinwa kuphela kungakwazisi lapho ukwethembeka kwemijaho kumbe umthetho kukudinga.
deletion.exportHint: Thatha ikhophi yolwazi lwakho kuqala nxa uyidinga.
deletion.recoveryHint: Usuguqule umqondo? Kuze kube lusuku lokususwa, sebenzisa "Khansela ukususwa kwe-akhawunti okulindileyo" ekhasini lokungena nge-imeyili lephasiwedi yakho.
deletion.scheduledBody: I-akhawunti yakho ivaliwe njalo ihlelelwe ukususwa ngomhla ka-{{date}}. Usengakukhansela kungakenzakali.
deletion.scheduledBodyNoDate: I-akhawunti yakho ivaliwe njalo ihlelelwe ukususwa. Usengakukhansela kungakenzakali.
deletion.successBody: I-akhawunti yakho ivaliwe njalo izasuswa ngomhla ka-{{date}}. Khathesi uzakhutshwa.
deletion.cancelFailed: Asikwazanga ukukhansela ukususwa. Ngicela uzame njalo.

blockers.ACCOUNT_DELETION_LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: Nguwe wedwa umphathi omkhulu osebenzayo. Yenza omunye umsebenzisi abe ngumphathi omkhulu ungakasusi i-akhawunti le.
blockers.ACCOUNT_DELETION_ACTIVE_RACES: Nguwe wedwa umhleli osebenzayo womjaho ovulekileyo, ovalelwe ukubhalisa, kumbe oqhubekayo. Engeza omunye umphathi womjaho, kumbe uqede kumbe ukhansele umjaho kuqala.

errors.ACCOUNT_DELETION_PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Faka iphasiwedi yakho ukuze ususe i-akhawunti yakho.
errors.ACCOUNT_DELETION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Bhala u-{{token}} njengoba unjalo ukuze uqinisekise.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Imizamo inengi kakhulu. Linda imizuzu embalwa ubusuzama njalo.
errors.generic: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle. Ngicela uzame njalo.
